audience: Authenticated users paging through the public game catalog, particularly games with tied names.
change: GET /api/v1/games orders by name ASC, id ASC.
scope_limit: No snapshot guarantee across inserts, deletes or sorting/filter changes; play history and score moderation lists remain outside this change.
readiness: Implementation and independent critic PostgreSQL/Router validation are documented in journal.md; release-specific gates and PDF regeneration are recorded in release-*.log.

release_convention.notes: Korean current-release paragraph in README.md; no CHANGELOG.md
release_convention.version_files: VERSION, docker-compose.yml, web and SDK package manifests/locks, versioned docs; internal/version values injected with ldflags

abort_criteria: Any required local gate failing prevents the local release; archive, clean-load, image vulnerability, live API and browser gate failures prevent workflow publication.

rollback.trigger: After deployment, any repeatable catalog name/id ordering regression or catalog API failure relative to v0.7.31 halts rollout.
rollback.action: Redeploy the retained v0.7.31 image using the existing deployment procedure; this patch introduces no schema migration.
rollback.local_execution: No service deployment was performed in this session.

follow_up: At the first deployment, the deployment operator checks readiness and catalog paging with tied names, and monitors catalog error/support reports for 24 hours. No deployment/adoption success is claimed by this preparation.
skill_loading: No dedicated Skill tool is exposed; installed SKILL.md files and references/sources.md were read directly. No store, advertising or license-policy determination required external source consultation.
